content_units: - A clean single-block morning schedule fits all items while finishing well before 17:00
- The longest uninterrupted discussion is kept at   85 minutes  , which satisfies the under-90-minute constraint
09:00-09:45   Quarterly goals review   Review Q results; confirm priorities; note blockers   Agreed goals status
09:45-10:25   Product risks   Surface top risks; assign severity; discuss mitigation   Risk list with owners
10:25-10:40   Break   Pause; reset; informal check-ins   Rested group
10:40-11:10   Hiring update   Review openings; pipeline status; hiring needs   Hiring status snapshot
11:10-11:30   Action summary   Confirm decisions; assign owners; set deadlines   Final action list
-   Ends by 11:30  , well before the 17:00 deadline.
-   Hiring update comes before action summary  , as required.
- Longest uninterrupted discussion block is   85 minutes   from 09:00 to 10:25.
- The   15-minute break   splits the meeting naturally before operational wrap-up.
- Keeping everything in the morning leaves the afternoon open for follow-ups or overflow if needed.
